prose.name: Defense: Treatment Bay at the <Place> on <Planet>
prose.briefing: A medic at the <Place> is mid-operation in a field treatment bay, and someone outside wants the painkillers in her cabinet.
prose.card: I'm mid-operation at the <Place>, and people outside want the painkillers in my cabinet. Keep them out until my patient is stable.

beats.objective: Talk to the medic at the <Place>

person.name: Halima Strand
hellos: Not now. Unless you're the help. Are you the help?

_bio.why_there: mid-operation when the raiders came for her painkillers (her lines, the briefing)
_bio.wants: her patient stable, and the door held (her lines)

greeting: Then listen. I've got a patient open on the table and people outside who want what's in my cabinet. Keep them out of this bay until I'm done.

reply: Every minute you give me is one he keeps.

exchanges.prompt: I can assist if you need another pair of hands.
reply: I need you on the door more. But come back after, and I'll show you what I did.

exchanges.prompt: What do they want with your cabinet?
reply: Painkillers. They'll sell them on. I'd rather they were in my patient.

beats.journal: Someone is coming for the medic's painkillers at the <Place>. I need to hold the treatment bay until her patient is stable.

beats.objective: Hold the treatment bay until the patient is stable
beats.journal: I held the medic's treatment bay at the <Place> until her patient was stable.
say: He's stable. You can stop shooting now. Please.

broadcast: The treatment bay's in the middle of the site. Come straight in, and don't stop to talk to anyone outside.
_speech: Halima: brisk, warm underneath, no time. A stand-in voice; his ear decides.
